text:
The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.

Based on your travel history and preferences, I recommend visiting Tanzania, specifically combining a safari in the Serengeti National Park with a stay in Zanzibar. The Serengeti offers abundant wildlife and is an excellent location for bird watching, which will appeal to your partner. Afterward, you can relax on the pristine white-sand beaches of Zanzibar, providing the beach relaxation you are looking for. This itinerary balances your interest in wildlife, your partner's hobby, and your desire for coastal downtime.
